scientific_integrity: Matroid and Tutte polynomial properties are standard prerequisites, not new theorems. Proof is all-parameter; finite enumeration only cross-checks small cases. Complexity result reduces to standard NP-complete three-coloring; no independent validation or audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite unlabeled partitions into exactly q nonempty blocks, 2<=q<=n; each query tests an unordered pair in a fixed simple graph H. No claim for balanced, geometric, connected, or optimal partitions. The q=1 shattering boundary differs; full trace criterion includes it. Historical priority under alternative terminology remains a risk.
title: Exact graphic-matroid shattering for fixed-block same-cluster queries
